# glinet_wireguard_peer (Resource)

Manage one peer on a WireGuard interface. Hardware operation is experimental. Keep a direct wired management path for changes and omit `preshared_key_wo` and `preshared_key_version` during adoption.

## Import existing configuration

Use an initialized project from [Check the router](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/glinet/latest/docs#check-the-router). Add this import block with your resource address and the existing object’s ID.

```terraform
import {
  to = glinet_wireguard_peer.peer
  id = "wg0:peer1"
}
```

1. Add the example’s resource block with the values already on the router.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to the router and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

If you are unsure what values to use, [generate a draft from the existing object](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import/generating-configuration). Keep the import block, omit the resource block, and run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf`. Review the draft before preparing the saved import plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
variable "wireguard_peer_public_key" {
  type = string
}

resource "glinet_wireguard_peer" "peer" {
  section       = "peer1"
  interface     = "wg0"
  public_key    = var.wireguard_peer_public_key
  allowed_ips   = ["10.8.0.2/32"]
  endpoint_host = "vpn.example"
  endpoint_port = 51820
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) WireGuard interface name, such as `wg0`.
- `public_key` (String) Peer public key.
- `section` (String) UCI wireguard peer section name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allowed_ips` (Set of String) Allowed IP CIDRs.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `description` (String) Peer description.
- `endpoint_host` (String) Peer endpoint host.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Peer endpoint port; zero leaves it unset.
- `persistent_keepalive` (Number) Persistent keepalive seconds.
- `preshared_key_version` (Number) Client-managed key generation. Increase it when rotating `preshared_key_wo`.
- `preshared_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only WireGuard preshared key.
- `route_allowed_ips` (Boolean) Install routes for allowed IPs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
